title: Doolittle’s crew abandons its bomber
basis: Use the pilot’s time at the end of the navigator’s five-minute interval; no second-level accuracy is claimed.

records.says: Pilot gives 21:20 ship time.
Navigator gives 21:15–21:20.

title: Confused early reports of Hallmark’s fate
basis: Use the later coastal account; do not map the unconfirmed Poyang report as a crash site.

records.says: Initial information placed Hallmark near Nanchang/Poyang and explicitly warned it was unreliable.
Crew 6 ditched; three captured.
Hallmark’s bomber ditched off Wenzhou. Dieter and Fitzmaurice drowned.
